note: This file is a Detectron2 configuration script with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It mutates an imported model config object to swap mask-RCNN components for keypoint-RCNN components. No CLI-invocable code is present.
configure_keypoint_rcnn_model: configure a detectron2 model to use keypoint detection instead of mask detection by updating roi_heads
set_keypoint_pooler: set the keypoint pooler with ROIAlignV2 using output size 14 and four FPN scales
set_keypoint_head: set the keypoint head using KRCNNConvDeconvUpsampleHead with 17 keypoints and 8 conv layers
adjust_post_nms_topk: adjust the proposal generator post_nms_topk to 1500 for training and 1000 for inference
set_smooth_l1_beta: set the box predictor smooth_l1_beta to 0.5 to improve keypoint AP
